notes.title: Version 0.0.7 updated
notes.content:
1, open normal difficulty (flying monsters will appear in the level)
2. Add new monsters
3. Added a new trap - anti-aircraft gun

notes.title: Version 0.0.6
notes.content:
1. Added English, French, German, Russian, Japanese, Korean 6 languages (machine translation)
2. Added defense type trap -- self-repair defense tower and its branches

notes.title: Version 0.0.5 updated
notes.content:
1: Improve monster damage calculation
2: Fix bugs when selling large traps quickly
3. Fixed the value of the magnetic storm energy tower
4. Add the sky material ball to make the scene located in the starry sky

notes.title: Version 0.0.4 updated
notes.content:
1. Game UI effect upgrade
2. New large unique trap - Magnetic Storm Energy Tower (unique)
3. New trap type Laser Chain - attacks can chain between monsters
3. New rouge abilities: Chain attack (increase the number of chain attacks), chain range (increase the range of chain enemies), light edge Refraction (chain attacks can attack the same target multiple times), mechanical army (double the ceiling of summoning trap summoners)
